Subject: Coordinating interregional technical deep dive — architect availability & DST

Hi Alex — great talking yesterday. Per our discussion, OptimaHealth engineering would like a technical deep dive (solutions engineer + customer architects) to review integration patterns, network requirements, and rollout steps. We want this to be a working session (90 minutes) so the architects can walk us through the current infra and we can map Redwood's routing/caching recommendations.

A couple logistics notes up front:
- We have coverage from Redwood in US (Marissa/Dev) and APAC (Hiro).
- US daylight savings starts 2026-03-08; we want to lock the meeting time accounting for the DST shift if the session falls in early March.

Proposed overlap windows (converted to local times for clarity):
1) Tue Mar 2 — 08:00 PT / 16:00 CET / 23:00 JST (tight for APAC)
2) Wed Mar 3 — 10:00 PT / 18:00 CET / 01:00 JST (next day)
3) Thu Mar 11 — 09:00 PT / 17:00 CET / 01:00 JST (note: this is after US DST change)

Can you confirm which of these (or other slots) work for your architects Sara and Wei? If none work, please send 2-3 windows you prefer this or next week and include timezone offsets.

I attached a short draft architecture deck and a slot grid to make booking easier. Once we agree on a time I’ll have Dev create a 90-minute invite and Hiro will lead the APAC-specific throughput discussion.

Thanks,
Marissa

Redwood Inference

Marissa — thanks for the clear options. Sara and Wei looked and here are realistic windows from our side (they are the architects and will need the full 90 minutes):

Option A: Wed Mar 3, 17:30-19:00 CET (08:30-10:00 PT) — Sara can do this; Wei can join remotely from Shanghai (01:30 CST next day) if it's unavoidable.
Option B: Tue Mar 9, 09:00-10:30 CET (00:00-01:30 PT) — this is rough for our US folks but possible for EU architects.
Option C: Thu Mar 11, 16:00-17:30 CET (08:00-09:30 PT) — preferred by both, but please note your earlier comment on DST: our calendars show EU stays on CET until late March, so the relative offsets will vary if you schedule before/after US DST.

We'd prefer Option C if Redwood can confirm Hiro and Dev are available (that gives us slightly nicer hours for Sara). If not, Option A is acceptable (we'll have Wei bridge late night from Shanghai).

Also, can you share a short pre-read (network ACEs, port list) so our infra team can pre-populate firewall requests?

—Alex
Head of Integrations, OptimaHealth
alex.mercer@optimah.com | +44 20 5555 1010

Thanks Alex — Option C (Thu Mar 11) works best for us too. Dev and Hiro are both available in that slot; I checked Hiro's APAC schedule and he can lead the session timing for the APAC specifics.

Action items before meeting:
- Dev: please create 90-min invite for Thu Mar 11, 16:00 CET / 08:00 PT / 00:00 JST (confirming offsets). Mark as 90 minutes.
- Dev/Hiro: attach the short network pre-read with ports, FQDNs, and proxy requirements. Alex requested this for firewall planning.
- Optima: Sara/Wei to share any current diagrams (if you want us to annotate ahead of time).

A quick note on DST: US switches on 2026-03-08. Since our session is on Mar 11 (after the shift), the PT time will be 08:00 (PDT) while CET remains unchanged; I will include both local times in the invite to avoid confusion.

I re-attached the architecture PDF and the slot grid in case anyone needs them.

Marissa
